items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw image 1, the mana light wave card edit target, preserving original SQUARE composition closely. A small intense white-violet energy intersection at the center, thin bright vertical lance of light extending toward top and bottom, and a pale violet-white curved horizontal beam sweeping from lower LEFT edge through center toward RIGHT edge where it levels out. A few branching white/pink sparks concentrate around the central intersection and along the right half of the horizontal beam. Keep beam trajectory, cross placement, thin beam thickness and open large blue-violet background. Pure symbolic magic light, no orb, character, hand, props or scenery. Simplify branching sparks into a small set of decisive short broken opaque strokes, central core brightest and clean, main beams clear. Deep muted blue-violet broad background planes with concentrated electric violet accents around cross, preserve source palette without fully saturating all planes. Images 2, 3, 4 are DRAWING STYLE references only; borrow broad opaque hand-painted construction, never subjects or costume motifs. Rough hand-painted anime color study with large connected opaque masses, a few wide directional swipes and blunt dabs, handmade edges and selective unfinished areas. Clear grouped hard-edged light and shadow, matte muted colored grays with concentrated richer accents. Quiet large areas. No glossy 3D, photorealism, uniformly thin vector outlines, tiny facet mosaics, dense fine lines or all-over grain/texture filters. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
